purpose: Reusable data context for football intelligence analysis, QA, dashboards and model evaluation.

freeSourceMode.principle: Core model training, source lineage and dashboards must keep working without paid sports API keys.

qualityGates.database: DATABASE_URL, POSTGRES_URL or SUPABASE_DB_URL must be configured before schema apply.
qualityGates.odds: ODDS_API_KEY or THE_ODDS_API_KEY plus ODDS_API_URL_TEMPLATE must be configured before ROI/CLV reporting.
qualityGates.prediction: Probabilities must sum to 1 and high confidence is blocked below 0.70 data completeness.
qualityGates.leakage: generated_at and cutoff_at must be before kickoff_at for pre-match snapshots.
qualityGates.lineage: Prediction-impacting fields should have source audit metadata.

dataAnalytics.role: Professional analysis hub for reusable context, KPI definitions, QA rules and dashboard contracts.

vercel.role: Deployment, environment variables, cron/workflow operations and storage integrations.
useFor: Future Vercel storage or marketplace Postgres integration

github.role: Source control, review flow, CI checks and branch-based worker data publishing.

slack.role: Optional alerting and digest delivery for stale worker, data-quality or deployment issues.

recommendedNextActions: Keep Neon connected and verify DATABASE_URL/POSTGRES_URL after each Vercel env pull.
Refresh followed club context with npm run context:clubs.
Use Football-Data.co.uk historical odds instead of paid live odds for ROI/CLV simulation.
Expand free source coverage per league before adding paid providers.
Enable Slack only after SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL is configured.
